title: 'X18N2002: Resource could not be parsed'
description: 'Resource could not be parsed. Fix the syntax error in the file.'
---

<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/generate.ts from the source code. Do not edit. -->

## Message

```
[X18N2002] Resource could not be parsed <detail>
├▶ fix: Fix the syntax error in the file.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n2002
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A locale file has a syntax error. The message names the file and the position.

1. Open the file and fix the syntax error.
2. Run `x18n check` again.

`x18n check` reports this as an `invalid-resource` diagnostic on the file.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
